title: Whom This Course is Intended for?

cues.en: Hello guys.
cues.zh: 大家好。

cues.en: Welcome back to the course.
cues.zh: 歡迎回到課程。

cues.en: In this video we are going to answer this particular question.
cues.zh: 這支影片會回答這個問題。

cues.en: This course is intended for based on my analysis there are three types of people who might be interested in this course.
cues.zh: 適合這門課？依我的分析，有三類人可能會對這門課感興趣。

cues.en: And those three types of people are also my main target students for this course.
cues.zh: 這三類人也是本課程的主要學習對象。

cues.en: Okay.

cues.en: Journalists and media professionals for professionals in the journalism and media industry, understanding
cues.zh: 記者與媒體專業人士。對新聞與媒體產業的專業人士而言，了解

cues.en: the technology and methodologies behind fake news detections is essential in today's digital landscape.
cues.zh: 假新聞偵測背後的技術和方法，在當今數位環境中十分重要。

cues.en: They can use this knowledge to evaluate information sources, verify stories and promote accurate reporting.
cues.zh: 他們可以運用這些知識評估資訊來源、查證報導，並促進正確的新聞報導。

cues.en: So.
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: If you are a journalist, this is definitely the right course for you because as a journalist, you don't want to accidentally report a fake news, right?
cues.zh: 如果你是記者，這門課很適合你；因為身為記者，你不會希望不小心報導假新聞，對吧？

cues.en: It's definitely going to impact your reputations and credibility.
cues.zh: 那肯定會影響你的聲譽與可信度。

cues.en: So in this course, you're going to learn to build a fake news detection system using machine learning model and big data.
cues.zh: 這門課會教你運用機器學習模型與大數據，建立假新聞偵測系統。

cues.en: So it's definitely going to be very useful because you're going to be able to check if a news is valid or not, if a news is real or fake.
cues.zh: 這非常實用，因為你將能檢查新聞是否有效、是真是假。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now let's move on to the second one here.
cues.zh: 接著看第二類。

cues.en: Data analysts and scientists.
cues.zh: 資料分析師與資料科學家。

cues.en: So data professionals want to apply their expertise in data analysis, machine learning and natural language processing to tackle the growing issues of fake news.
cues.zh: 資料專業人士希望運用資料分析、機器學習與自然語言處理的專業能力，處理日益嚴重的假新聞問題。

cues.en: So with their quantitative and analytical skills, they can play a pivotal role in developing rabies detection models.
cues.zh: 憑藉量化分析能力，他們能在開發穩健的偵測模型方面扮演關鍵角色。

cues.en: So if you are a data analyst or a data scientist, this is also the right course for you guys.
cues.zh: 如果你是資料分析師或資料科學家，這門課也很適合你。

cues.en: So in this course we're going to use Python as our programming language alongside with several libraries like pandas, NumPy, matplotlib and scikit learn.
cues.zh: 課程會使用 Python，以及 pandas、NumPy、Matplotlib 和 scikit-learn 等函式庫。

cues.en: Not only that, you're also going to learn how to clean the data.
cues.zh: 不僅如此，你也會學到如何清理資料。

cues.en: All right, so before building the fake news detection system we're going to clean the data.
cues.zh: 在建立假新聞偵測系統前，我們會先清理資料。

cues.en: First we're going to remove all missing values and duplicates.
cues.zh: 首先移除所有缺失值與重複資料。

cues.en: Then what we're going to do next is to explore the data sets from multiple angles.
cues.zh: 接下來，再從不同角度探索資料集。

cues.en: So we're going to analyze the data.
cues.zh: 我們會分析資料。

cues.en: First we're going to visualize the data.
cues.zh: 先將資料視覺化。

cues.en: All right then once we are familiar with the data once we know what the data looks like then we're going
cues.zh: 熟悉資料、了解資料樣貌之後，就會

cues.en: to build the fake news detections system.
cues.zh: 建立假新聞偵測系統。

cues.en: So we're going to use a logistic regressions.
cues.zh: 我們將使用邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: We're going to use random forest which is a machine learning algorithm.
cues.zh: 也會使用機器學習演算法隨機森林。

cues.en: And we're also going to use feature engineering.
cues.zh: 還會使用特徵工程。

cues.en: So yeah it's going to be a very complex project guys.
cues.zh: 所以這會是一個相當複雜的專案。

cues.en: But don't worry you're going to learn a lot.
cues.zh: 但別擔心，你會學到很多。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now let's move on to the next one here.
cues.zh: 接著看下一類。

cues.en: Policymakers and government officials.
cues.zh: 政策制定者與政府官員。

cues.en: Policymakers and government officials who need to address the societal impact of fake news can benefit
cues.zh: 需要處理假新聞社會影響的政策制定者與政府官員，可以透過

cues.en: from understanding the technologies and strategies used to combat disinformation.
cues.zh: 了解對抗不實資訊的技術與策略而受益。

cues.en: They can develop informed policies and regulations to mitigate the effects of fake news.
cues.zh: 他們能制定有依據的政策與法規，降低假新聞的影響。

cues.en: So if you are a policy maker who work in government, this is also the right course for you guys.
cues.zh: 如果你是在政府工作的政策制定者，這門課也很適合你。

cues.en: So even if you are not really interested in data science, even if you are not really interested in machine learning or programming, you're still going to learn a lot.
cues.zh: 即使你對資料科學、機器學習或程式設計沒有特別感興趣，仍然會學到很多。

cues.en: So in this course, we're going to talk about several factors that contribute to the widespread of fake news and misinformation, for example, like confirmation bias, political manipulations and social
cues.zh: 我們會討論促使假新聞與錯誤資訊廣泛傳播的因素，例如確認偏誤、政治操弄，以及社群

cues.en: media echo chambers.
cues.zh: 媒體同溫層。

cues.en: So you're going to identify the cause of the problem first.
cues.zh: 你會先找出問題的成因。

cues.en: Then you're going to build the solution using machine learning.
cues.zh: 再透過機器學習建立解決方案。

cues.zh: 好，以上就是全部內容。

cues.zh: 這就是目前需要知道的資訊。
